title: Find the subintervals
text: Here $$f(x)=\frac{1}{x} cos\left(x\right)$$. The width of each subinterval is $$\frac{0.5-0.1}{4}=0.1$$. The endpoints of the subintervals are $$0.1$$, $$0.2$$, $$0.3$$, $$0.4$$ and $$0.5$$.

title: Apply the rule
text: Compute $$S_4=\frac{1}{30} \left(f{\left(0.1\right)}+4f{\left(0.2\right)}+2f{\left(0.3\right)}+4f{\left(0.4\right)}+f{\left(0.5\right)}\right)$$, which comes out to about $$1.563$$.
